results.title: 5 Thoughts: Texas A&M 101, Southeastern Louisiana 69
results.description: A tale of two halves saw the Aggies go from leading by three points at halftime to running away with another blowout victory in another "buy" game at Reed Arena. While Texas A&M is 5-0 on the season, improvement in key areas is required as the non-conference schedule is about to ramp up.
